description_en: Updates the basic information of an authorization rule
description_zh: 修改授权规则基本信息
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost modify-rule --instance-id bastionhost-cn-zmb2y9ydw08 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --rule-id 68 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyRule

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Bastionhost instance to which the authorization rule to be updated belongs. > You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to obtain the value of this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
要修改的授权规则所在堡垒机实例的ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the Bastionhost instance to which the authorization rule to be updated belongs. > For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
要修改授权规则所在的堡垒机的地域ID。
地域ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the authorization rule to be updated
parameters.name: rule_id

parameters.help_en: The new name of the authorization rule. The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with a special character. It can contain only periods (.), underscores (_), hyphens (-), single quotation marks ('), and spaces
parameters.help_zh: 修改后的授权规则名称。长度为1~128个字符，不能以特殊字符开头，只可包含特殊字符中的半角句号（）、下划线（_）、短划线（-）、半角单引号（'）以及空格
parameters.name: rule_name

parameters.help_en: The new remarks for the authorization rule. The remarks can be up to 500 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 指定修改后授权规则的备注信息，最多支持500字符
parameters.name: comment

parameters.help_en: The new start time of the validity period for the authorization rule. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds
parameters.help_zh: 修改后授权规则有效期开始时间（秒，时间戳格式）
parameters.name: effective_start_time

parameters.help_en: The new end time of the validity period for the authorization rule. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds
parameters.help_zh: 修改后授权规则有效期结束时间（秒，时间戳格式）
parameters.name: effective_end_time

parameters.help_en: The new list of user IDs associated with the authorization rule
parameters.help_zh: 修改后授权规则关联的用户ID列表
parameters.name: user_ids

parameters.help_en: The new list of user group IDs associated with the authorization rule
parameters.help_zh: 修改后授权规则关联的用户组ID列表
parameters.name: user_group_ids

fields.help_en: The list of host account IDs
fields.name: host_account_ids

parameters.help_en: The new array of host IDs and host account IDs associated with the authorization rule
parameters.help_zh: 修改后授权规则关联的主机ID与主机账户ID数组
parameters.name: hosts

fields.help_en: The list of database account IDs
fields.name: database_account_ids

parameters.help_en: The new list of database instances and database accounts associated with the authorization rule
parameters.help_zh: 修改后授权的数据库实例和数据库账户列表
parameters.name: databases

fields.help_en: The list of asset account names
fields.name: host_account_names

parameters.help_en: The new list of asset groups and accounts associated with the authorization rule
parameters.help_zh: 修改后授权的资产组和账户列表
parameters.name: host_groups

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符
